name: prize-entry
title: Prize entry
description: The draw entry form, and the state after it. REQ-051 asks for the path from login to code to entry to entered, so the confirmation is part of this component rather than a screen the host is left to invent: pass `entered` and it renders what the player is now in, carrying `data-gs-complete`. Consent is never assumed. No box starts ticked and no prop could tick one, required and optional are stated in words beside each box, and the entry control stays unavailable until every required consent is given, saying what to do rather than saying no. It enters nobody into anything: it collects the fields and the consents and hands them to the host, which runs the draw.
docs: Pass `prize` for what they are playing for, your own `field` components as children, and `consents` as `[{ name, label, requirement }]`. `onSubmit` gives you the fields and the ticked consents together, keyed by name, and it never fires while a required consent is missing. Set `busy` while you take the entry and pass `errors` when you reject it. When your own call comes back accepted, re-render with `entered` and an `entry` carrying the entry number and when the draw happens, plus `onDone` for the way back to the game. Find the entry control with `[data-gs-part="submit"]` and the entered state with `[data-gs-complete]`.
